design:
Child epic of the nuclear refinery programme (bn op-upme).

**Fidelity target: Crude estimate now, Engineering model target**

**Required for heavy crude.**

```
atmospheric residue -> VDU -> LVGO / HVGO / vacuum residue
```

**No `VacuumColumn` currently exists.** Audit whether existing rigorous-column
APIs can naturally represent vacuum operation and accept the actual CDU residue
stream.

## Required eventually

reduced-pressure operation; **atmospheric-residue feed identity preserved**;
LVGO; HVGO; vacuum residue; heater duty; pressure profile; optional stripping
steam; conservation.

## The binding constraint

**Do not manually reconstruct a new unrelated crude from CDU residue. CDU
output must be consumable as VDU input.** If `cdu.atmospheric_residue()`
returns a flow rate rather than a stream carrying composition, enthalpy and
pressure, the design must change -- this has to be undone the moment a second
unit is chained, and again when HTGR heat integration arrives.

Depends on the stream model (lumping epic).

## Out of scope for this pass (programme-wide)

Do not: port DWSIM UI or graphical flowsheet objects; port CAPE-OPEN unless a
concrete backend requirement exists; reproduce .NET class architecture; make
DWSIM depend on Outram-FOAM; solve thousands of molecular species in the CDU;
implement molecular reconstruction before assay/pseudocomponent CDU works; call
a converged model validated without reference evidence; hide conservation
errors; push to `main`.
title: Refinery: VDU

description:
Cross-sectionally averaged void fraction at axial stations in a vertical heated tube, upward flow. Range: p to 15 MPa, G to 2000 kg/m2/s, q to 2.2 MW/m2. Wall and subcooled liquid temperature available for one condition.

Citation: Bartolomej, G. G. & Chanturiya, V. M., 'Experimental study of true void fraction when boiling subcooled water in vertical tubes', Thermal Engineering 14 (1967) 123-128.

Access problem: the original Russian-journal paper is hard to obtain. The data is digitised in open-access validation papers, e.g. arXiv:1709.01783 (OpenFOAM two-phase boiling). Digitisation provenance MUST be recorded the way marviken_tests.rs records its graphreader points — which paper, which figure, which reader tool.

Scope context: crates/tampines-steam-tables/docs/validation-scope-turbine-and-pipe.md section 4.2.
title: V&V: subcooled boiling void fraction — Bartolomei & Chanturiya (1967)

description:
From the op-ffg6 audit, 2026-08-13. THIS IS THE ONE PART OF THE AUDIT THAT DEFEATED TEXT ANALYSIS. Small analysis, then mechanical. Defer until C1-C7 are done.

245 sites are HeatTransferEntity conversions via into()/try_into().unwrap(). The agent judged them genuinely ambiguous:
  - roughly half convert an entity the SAME FUNCTION JUST CONSTRUCTED -- genuinely infallible, bucket (c), leave alone
  - roughly half convert a CALLER-SUPPLIED entity -- genuinely fallible, bucket (a), and TypeConversionErrorHeatTransferEntity
    already exists for exactly this

Separating the two needs TYPE INFORMATION, not grep. The auditing agent had no LSP/rust-analyzer in its toolset and said
so plainly. Per CLAUDE.md this is exactly what the rust-analyzer LSP tool is for -- use findReferences / hover on the
conversion sites rather than another text pass.

Do not attempt this with a blanket sed. Getting it wrong in the infallible direction adds noise; getting it wrong in the
fallible direction hides a real failure.
title: C8 TUAS: decide the into()/try_into() HeatTransferEntity conversion policy (245 ambiguous sites)

description: Follow-up to op-1arj's module move (src/digitiser/gui/desktop -> src/app, done 2026-09-01). op-9vo6's scoping-pass finding #1 named two problems: the app state's location (fixed by op-1arj) AND its name -- 'DigitiseApp -- the digitiser OWNS the application' is backwards; the app shell owns the digitiser as one of its panels, not the other way round. op-1arj deliberately deferred the rename (kept DigitiseApp as-is) to keep that pass a pure, mechanical, low-risk path relocation rather than bundling a symbol rename with a directory move in one diff. Doing the rename now means: pick a new name (e.g. KovanApp / AppShell), touch every reference within crates/kovan/src/app/*.rs (all ~10 files reference DigitiseApp via use/impl/struct), plus the one external call site in digitiser/gui/mod.rs::run(). Use kopitiam rename if its rust-analyzer rename-capability bug (kopitiam#30, still open as of 2026-09-01) has been fixed upstream; otherwise the documented fallback (grep every reference, hand-edit, let cargo check catch misses) that op-1arj itself and the 2026-08-19 path-length refactor both used successfully.
title: Rename DigitiseApp to reflect app-shell (not digitiser) ownership
